title: Homeschooling Just Passed Catholic Schools
source: US K-12 enrollment estimates compiled from National Home Education Research Institute (NHERI) homeschool figures (drawing on NCES/Census Household Pulse Survey data) and National Catholic Educational Association (NCEA) annual enrollment reports: homeschooled students grew from about 850,000 in 1999 to an estimated 3.4 million by the 2024-2025 school year, while Catholic school enrollment fell from roughly 2.65 million to about 1.68 million over the same span, with the two lines crossing around 2019-2020.
